capabilities: Drag-resize table column widths with per-table persistence
Auto-fit column widths to content, including on scroll into view
Style table headers (first row/column, bold, color)
Configure table layout mode, width, vertical alignment and line height
Clear saved column widths for the current file via command
extras: Bilingual (Chinese/English) README; manifest carries a 'not manually reviewed' notice; stores column-width fingerprints in its own data.json without modifying note content; supports mobile.
intentEvidence: instant apply in both reading view and live preview — no hand-written CSS
problem: Markdown tables in Obsidian have no built-in way to adjust column widths or style headers, forcing users to write CSS snippets per table.
summary: Visual table layout plugin that adds header styling, drag-to-resize column widths with per-table memory, auto-fit, and adaptive fill without hand-written CSS.
